instagram.caption:
Its own set, or nothing.
The Outdoor Dining Zone in the Patio or Deck. Feed people outdoors without carrying the kitchen out in four trips.

What done looks like:
1. A bare tabletop except the umbrella
2. One weighted tray
3. Six chairs tucked fully under
4. String lights clipped along the rail with no cord crossing the floor

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success outdoor dining zone.
